title: Testbench Experiment
description: Schema for defining experiments to evaluate agent responses.

llm_as_a_judge_model.description: The specific LLM used to grade responses (e.g., 'gpt-4o', 'gemini-1.5-pro').

default_threshold.description: The fallback threshold used across all evaluations if not specified at the metric level.

evaluations.description: List of metric configurations to evaluate this step.

input.description: User input to the agent at this step.

custom_values.description: Additional key-value pairs to include in the test results for this step.

metrics.description: List of metric configurations to evaluate this step.
